units.function: Mocked route tests preventing comment-triggered activity and checkout on an Issue linked to an archived isolated workspace while allowing a board user to migrate it.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest -> Issue route guards -> mocked Issue/execution-workspace/access/heartbeat/activity services; no database or execution-environment lifecycle is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Issue executionWorkspaceId, archived isolated workspace with closedAt, comment/PATCH/checkout commands and replacement workspace ID.
units.lifecycle: Resolve linked workspace -> reject execution-affecting comment or checkout when archived -> permit non-comment board update to a replacement workspace -> future execution may resume outside this unit.
units.testAssessment: Sandboxed run failed 4/4 on TCP bind; approved unsandboxed run passed 4/4. Guard behavior is clear, but only a local board actor and mocked services are covered; no cleanup, retention, file access or concurrency is proven.
units.designRationale: Prevent new work from running against a closed isolated workspace without trapping the Issue permanently, since an operator can move it to another workspace.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must close execution authority and ephemeral resources without deleting responsibility discussion or immutable evidence, and must explicitly govern migration/reactivation to another execution environment.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the fail-closed workspace-state precondition and explicit migration escape hatch. Split append-only Discussion/Evidence commands from Agent-waking execution commands, return stable codes/remediation, verify tenant/workspace ownership, use optimistic versions and record closure/migration/reactivation receipts plus retention/legal-hold policy.
units.responsibilityConflict: Freezing all comments can prevent humans from documenting accountability after execution closes, while moving workspace lacks an asserted approval/evidence chain. Execution closure must not erase or block responsibility records.
evidence: git history: 9 commits from b13eb5b2b5cc7ad721f96b914c55dad9e66c5f81 through 73eb23734f25c570d88665e672f80d740797c632 recorded in read ledger

units.securityFindings: HIGH lifecycle-coverage gap: runtime cleanup, files, secrets, leases, retention and legal hold are absent. HIGH responsibility-availability risk: workspace closure blocks all new comments. MEDIUM authorization gap: Agent/cross-tenant/inactive membership cases are untested. MEDIUM race gap: close/migrate/checkout concurrency and version checks are absent. MEDIUM audit gap: closure and migration receipts are not asserted. MEDIUM error-contract gap: denials depend on English text.
